ValidationRule.description: Released, Pending Approval and Pending Prepayment are set by Business Central through the Integration User and cannot be selected manually.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Released"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Pending_Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Pending_Prepayment") ), TRIM($User.FirstName & " " & $User.LastName) <> "Integration User", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Order.Bypass_Validation_CC__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Released, Pending Approval and Pending Prepayment can only be set by Business Central.
